Single Replication from the Simulation Study

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Source: vignettes/sim-rep.Rmd
sim-rep.Rmd
library(OpenMx)
library(fitVARMxID)
library(metaDyn)
library(manMetaVAR)

Data Generation 

taskid <- 1
seed <- 42
set.seed(seed)
data <- GenData(
  taskid = taskid,
  seed = seed
)
plot(data)

summary(data)
#>        id            time            y1               y2        
#>  Min.   : 1.0   Min.   : 0.0   Min.   :-2.526   Min.   :-2.872  
#>  1st Qu.:13.0   1st Qu.:12.0   1st Qu.: 1.749   1st Qu.: 1.306  
#>  Median :25.5   Median :24.5   Median : 2.939   Median : 2.340  
#>  Mean   :25.5   Mean   :24.5   Mean   : 2.898   Mean   : 2.366  
#>  3rd Qu.:38.0   3rd Qu.:37.0   3rd Qu.: 4.006   3rd Qu.: 3.443  
#>  Max.   :50.0   Max.   :49.0   Max.   : 8.150   Max.   : 9.063

MetaVAR 

dtvar <- FitDTVAR(
  data = data,
  seed = seed
)
summary(dtvar, means = TRUE)
#> Call:
#> FitVARMxID(data = data$data, observed = paste0("y", seq_len(model$k)),

  fit = dtvar,
  seed = seed
)

Mplus

  data = data,
  seed = seed
)
summary(mplus)
